en.joke: My phone's battery life is the only thing more dependable than my motivation to do adulting tasks.
en.explanation: It's a relatable, self-deprecating observation about procrastination and our reliance on tech, stated with ironic seriousness.

people.name: Salma Hayek
people.extract: Salma Valgarma Hayek Pinault is a Mexican and American actress and film producer. She began her career in Mexico with starring roles in the telenovela Teresa (1989–1991) as well as the romantic drama Midaq Alley (1995). She soon established herself in Hollywood with appearances in films such as Desperado (1995), From Dusk till Dawn (1996), Wild Wild West (1999), and Dogma (1999).
highlights: Mexican and American actress and film producer.
Appeared in Hollywood films Desperado and From Dusk till Dawn.

people.name: Ramón Valdés
people.extract: Ramón Esteban Gómez-Valdés y Castillo was a Mexican actor and comedian. He is best remembered for his portrayal of Don Ramón in the Mexican sitcom El Chavo del Ocho. He is also recognized as one of Mexico's best comedians.
highlights: Best known as Don Ramón in El Chavo del Ocho.
Recognized as one of Mexico's best comedians.

people.name: Choi Ye-bin
people.extract: Choi Ye-bin is a South Korean actress. She is best known for role in The Penthouse: War in Life (2020–2021), where she rose to prominence for playing the villainous soprano student Ha Eun-byeol.
highlights: Best known for The Penthouse: War in Life.
Played villainous soprano student Ha Eun-byeol in The Penthouse.
